description: The vendors the engine (scripts/) may call and where (D-069 item 7, plan v3.1 R1). Validated by contracts/adapters/engine-vendors.v1.json and read by scripts/lib/vendor_check.py through providers.vendor_catalog. A baseline site is a call outside the adapters that predates the check: it moves behind its port as its unit migrates (U4), and the list only shrinks. A slot with no caller keeps its detectors, so a new call is refused until its port exists (OU-DECOUPLE F5, D-113).

vendors.name: github
vendors.note: The forge today (P-02). The forge port is scripts/lib/forge_events.py (M2); github_api.py is the one REST client and github_cli.py its gh-compatible shim. Cursor Origin is the next forge adapter (P-34).

vendors.name: github-actions
vendors.note: Never a CI runner (AGENTS.md: no GitHub Actions or third-party CI). The CI runner port is scripts/lib/adapters/ci_runner.py; its adapter is the local gate runner.

vendors.name: claude
vendors.note: The agent provider today; port scripts/lib/adapters/agent.py.

vendors.name: codex
vendors.note: Documented slot of the agent port (adapters/agent.py SLOTS); no adapter yet.

vendors.name: cursor
vendors.note: Documented slot of the agent port (adapters/agent.py SLOTS); no adapter yet.

vendors.name: cloudflare-r2
vendors.note: No engine caller: the product media storage that used it left the repository (OU-DECOUPLE F4, D-111). An engine shared store would be an adapter of scripts/lib/adapters/storage.py.

vendors.name: figma
vendors.note: Design specs. No engine caller since the product that read them left the repository (OU-DECOUPLE F4, D-111).
